newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's foreign debt falls $16.6 mln in July.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's foreign debt falls $16.6 mln in July.

text.p: Lebanon's foreign debt fell $16.6 million in July to $1.54 billion from $1.55 billion in June, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Wednesday.
Foreign debt stood at nearly $1.29 billion in December 1995.
Net total public debt rose 409 billion Lebanese pounds in July to 14,082 billion pounds against 13,673 billion in June, the Bank said.

"The increase in debt was mainly due to the rise in net domestic debt which reached at end July 11,676.4 billion Lebanese pounds against 11,233.9 billion at end March, increasing by 442.5 billion," the Bank added.
